[EN] I should have known something was up when the high elves asked me to come to Balder's Refuge. They didn't mention anything about the sloths, baboons, or arkai infestations. Go figure.
[ES] Tendría que haber sospechado cuando los high elves me pidieron que viniera a Balder's Refuge. No mencionaron nada sobre las plagas de perezosos, babuinos o arkai. Qué le vamos a hacer.
